abstract: The PwC Global AI Jobs Barometer 2025 reports that AI-skilled workers command a significant 56% wage premium compared to the prior year's 25%, with median AI role compensation reaching $157,000 versus $49,500 across all occupations. This analysis demonstrates the substantial and growing compensation advantage for workers with artificial intelligence expertise in the global labor market.
keyFindings: AI-skilled workers command a 56% wage premium, up from 25% in the prior year.
Median compensation for AI roles is $157,000 compared to $49,500 across all occupations.
The wage premium for AI skills has more than doubled year-over-year.
qualifiers: Limited excerpt provided; full methodology and scope details not available in source text.
